issuer.name: 中国神华能源股份有限公司
issuer.identity_evidence: 2025 annual report identifies A share 601088 and H share 01088.
identity_gaps: No case-local, point-in-time listing, suspension, risk-warning, delisting, code-change, and free-float history is archived.
No frozen security-status ledger exists for the research cutoff.

classification.admission_rationale: Case-archived primary filings establish an issuer-by-issuer research starting point only. G0-G9 contain unresolved hard evidence gaps, especially a complete statutory archive, point-in-time corporate-action reconstruction, licensed market data, valuation, liquidity, and independent review.

research_questions: How do coal volume and price, purchased-coal mix, transportation, power, coal chemicals, project spending, and safety/environmental constraints transmit into operating cash generation?
Can 2025-2026 common-control acquisitions, restatements, financing, and share-capital changes be reconstructed without contaminating cross-period and per-share comparisons?
Can disclosed cash-distribution events be reconciled to implementation, tax, funding sources, investment needs, debt, and restricted cash without extrapolation?
Can control, related-party, audit, governance, regulatory, safety, and environmental risks pass a dated independent negative-evidence review?
Can a licensed, point-in-time market and corporate-action dataset later support independent reconstruction of valuation and liquidity?
out_of_scope: Stock selection, portfolio construction, universe freeze, backtest, or external market action.
Current-price, valuation-multiple, target-price, upside/downside, total-return, or liquidity conclusion.
Any assertion that past distribution events imply a future cash-flow or distribution outcome.

relationship_to_prior_case_work.c38: This is the issuer-specific diligence implementation of the C38 provisional research queue; it does not upgrade C38's direct-equity route.
relationship_to_prior_case_work.c24: C24 remains controlling for direct-A-share data rights, point-in-time universe, corporate actions, market data, cost, and execution feasibility.
relationship_to_prior_case_work.c34: This artifact does not repair, replace, re-parameterize, or infer a result from the failed C34 ETF proxy candidate.

reported_observations.limitation: The 2024 comparative period was restated after the Hangjin Energy common-control acquisition. These reported facts do not establish free cash flow, cycle position, financial quality, or valuation.
No standalone external/internal revenue, transfer-price, customer-contract, cash-collection, or sensitivity bridge is reconstructed.
The report is unaudited and cannot be annualised or treated as a full-year outcome.

reported_observations.topic: 2026 first-quarter acquisition, funding, and share-capital discontinuity
reported_observations.limitation: This is a corporate-action and accounting-boundary warning, not a valuation, dilution, financing-quality, or cash-flow conclusion.

reported_observations.comparability_notice: The issuer says that from April 2026 the operating data includes newly consolidated assets and that comparative data was retrospectively adjusted.
reported_observations.limitation: Monthly operating data is not audited earnings, cash flow, distribution coverage, or a forecast.
A plan is not realised cash flow or a forward return estimate.
The H-share payment date is after this artifact's cutoff. The current case lacks the A-share implementation notice, holder-specific tax treatment, payment reconciliation, and funding-coverage audit.

reported_observations.topic: control, related parties, internal control, and proposed auditor change

facts.2026_auditor_change_status_in_located_no: EYHM and EY proposed, subject to general-meeting approval

reported_observations.limitation: Issuer disclosures do not substitute for a dated independent negative-evidence review, related-party actual-amount reconciliation, or a final auditor-appointment record as of the cutoff.

gate_assessment.name: scope_and_security_identity
hard_gaps: No complete point-in-time security-status, mapping, suspension, warning, delisting, and free-float ledger.
gate_assessment.disposition: Do not enter a comparable research sample.

gate_assessment.name: complete_statutory_disclosure_archive
hard_gaps: The 2023-2024 annual reports, latest interim report, correction/version chain, complete document inventory, and first-public timestamps are incomplete.
The archived C42-S01--S07 source set is partial and does not establish a complete statutory disclosure archive.

gate_assessment.name: business_and_operating_drivers
hard_gaps: No source-complete matrix for permits, reserves, projects, customers, transfer pricing, external/internal volumes, costs, competition, and policy exposure.
No independent operating-driver bridge to earnings or cash flow.

gate_assessment.name: earnings_quality_and_balance_sheet
hard_gaps: No independently rebuilt revenue-to-operating-cash, working-capital, capex, debt, restricted-cash, mining-right, impairment, minority-interest, and related-party bridge.
Common-control restatements and 2026 acquisition/financing effects are not reconciled.

gate_assessment.name: distribution_and_cash_flow_coverage
hard_gaps: No A-share implementation notice, holder-specific tax treatment, payment reconciliation, or funding-coverage audit.
No historical event ledger distinguishes proposal, approval, implementation, record, ex-rights, and payment dates.

gate_assessment.name: governance_control_and_compliance
hard_gaps: No independent regulatory, litigation, pledge, disciplinary, safety, environmental, and negative-search log.
No reconciliation of related-party actual amounts and no final auditor-appointment evidence as of the cutoff.

gate_assessment.name: valuation_and_disconfirmation
hard_gaps: No same-as-of unadjusted price/status, verified total/free-float shares, net debt, contingent liabilities, comparable-company evidence, original broker evidence, model, or independent audit.

gate_assessment.name: liquidity_and_tradable_status
hard_gaps: No written data-use rights or retained historical unadjusted price, volume, value, no-trade, suspension, price-limit, free-float, field-dictionary, revision-log, and coverage package.

gate_assessment.name: point_in_time_and_corporate_actions
hard_gaps: No complete first-public-time, raw-price, share-capital, acquisition, issuance, lock-up, distribution, adjustment-factor, algorithm, and correction/withdrawal ledger.
The 2026-08-14 SSE operating-data file has no retained binary, hash, or first-public timestamp in the case.

gate_assessment.name: independent_review
hard_gaps: No reviewer other than the author has re-extracted financials, reconciled corporate actions, audited distribution coverage, checked negative governance evidence, or verified source hashes.

risks_and_research_stop_conditions.question: Can coal price, volume, purchased-coal mix, and group/customer concentration be separated into independently evidenced gross-profit and cash-flow drivers?
risks_and_research_stop_conditions.stop_condition: If internal/external revenue, costs, prices, volumes, and related-party flows cannot be separately reconciled, stop financial-quality analysis.

risks_and_research_stop_conditions.question: Can the 2025-2026 acquisition, cash payment, borrowings, issuance, restrictions, and accounting restatement be reconstructed point in time?
risks_and_research_stop_conditions.stop_condition: If transaction consideration, accounting boundary, share capital, lock-up, or corporate-action timing cannot be reconstructed, retain G3/G6/G8 blocks.

risks_and_research_stop_conditions.question: Can safety, environmental, climate, permit, project, and regulatory evidence be independently archived and reconciled?
risks_and_research_stop_conditions.stop_condition: Without a primary-source and negative-search archive, do not conclude that these risks are cleared.

risks_and_research_stop_conditions.question: Can each distribution event be reconciled through proposal, approval, implementation, timing, tax, and funding coverage?
risks_and_research_stop_conditions.stop_condition: Any missing implementation, tax, payment, or coverage evidence leaves G4 uncleared.

risks_and_research_stop_conditions.question: Can control, related-party actuals, minority protection, auditor change, and adverse evidence pass independent review?
risks_and_research_stop_conditions.stop_condition: Absent actual-amount reconciliation, negative search, and auditor appointment status, G5 remains uncleared.

risks_and_research_stop_conditions.question: Can an authorized data package reconstruct displayed prices, status, liquidity, and corporate actions without assuming execution?
risks_and_research_stop_conditions.stop_condition: Non-authorized, non-replayable, or close-only data cannot unlock G7/G8.

The SSE July-2026 operating-data file remains a locator only; direct retrieval yielded an anti-bot response, not the announced PDF, and no first-public timestamp is retained.

data_quality.confidence_scope: Feasibility of beginning issuer-specific primary-document collection only; no confidence is assigned to financial quality, governance, valuation, liquidity, performance, or strategy usability.
